# Sarkar Vantage

> Vantage is a 100ml unisex spiced woody parfum from the Sarkar perfume house (sister to Throne, Regal, Noble and Orion). Price: ₹1,499 incl. taxes. Free shipping across India, 2 complimentary 7ml samples, ships in 24–36 hours.

## Notes
- Top: Grapefruit, Ginger
- Heart: Cardamom, Violet Leaf
- Base: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Ambergris

## Facts
- Concentration: parfum, 25% oil
- Longevity: up to 8 hours
- Season: all year; suitable for daily wear
